youtube.title: Why Lighthouse Lenses Are Made of Rings 💡 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The Fresnel lens was developed by Augustin-Jean Fresnel in the 1820s. A normal lens that powerful would be extremely thick and heavy, and thick glass absorbs light. Fresnel kept only the curved surfaces and removed the glass between them, creating concentric rings that bend light into a bright beam seen from many miles away.
